text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. It's an event where the 
Umamusume entertain their fans through 
various competitions, but—

Even so, since this was a regular 
occurrence, I calmly went to look for 
places where Seiun Sky might be. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sky-san, that's unseemly.

The one with Seiun Sky was King Halo. As I 
wondered why such a serious girl was on 
the rooftop—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, no one's even looking~. Besides, 
King, aren't you supposed to be competing 
in an event?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A refined young lady slacking off? Now, 
that would be truly unseemly, wouldn't 
it~?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm not slacking off! ...I'm just taking a 
short break.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You say that, but you really just ran 
away, didn't you? After all, reporters 
would be hounding you with, "What's the 
reason for your madness?" and all~

"Lately, King Halo has been running mile 
and sprint races. I knew the reporters 
were making a fuss over her sudden change 
of direction, but..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what brought on this change of heart? 
Give the scoop exclusively to the Sky 
Newspaper~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...Huh. What's with that intense stare?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Did you tell me already? Or did I say 
something—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: N-No! Sky-san isn't the reason.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"I simply took another look at my own 
path— the path the King ought to take."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm not running from the 
reporters either. I have no regrets or 
shame about the path I chose."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: However, right now, just for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just a little?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's nothing. I'm heading back now.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just stay right there and watch! Witness a 
first-rate media interview, King style!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry, teased you too much. You 
don't have to panic like that, really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Twenty minutes, got it.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I had to head out soon anyway. I'll go be 
everyone's idol for twenty minutes."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King, why don't you bite your handkerchief 
in jealousy while watching my magnificent 
fan service~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Also, when you're tired, you should just 
honestly say, 'I'm exhausted!'

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just like me~.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wait, Sky-san—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Foolish girl. I won't end up like 
you."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san. Were you eavesdropping by 
any chance? Geez~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Not necessarily. There's barely 
anything others can do, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, the only one you can truly 
rely on... is yourself, you know."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Right then! Time to go do some fan 
service!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And so, Trainer, I have a favor to 
ask—

Seiun Sky's request was to gather as many 
fans and reporters visiting the Fan 
Appreciation Festival as possible. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky-san! What kind of strategy are 
you going with for the upcoming Tenno Sho 
(Spring)!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Come on, share your secret tactics just 
with me~! I'll trade ya for some info on 
secret fishing spots!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, you're so cute♪ Take a picture 
with us!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy, I was here first~! Sky-chan, let me 
be your sugar mommy!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, pure chaos!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, it's just as ordered. The only 
question now is whether I can control it 
properly—"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky~!! So cute~! Let me give you 
some pats~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I might not have what it takes. 
Nyahaha...

Afterward, Seiun Sky somehow managed to 
handle all the fans and reporters... 
though she seemed a bit worn out.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, you're so cute♪ Take a picture 
with us!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, we gathered quite a good amount♪ As 
expected of you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Now, now, just watch and see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, reporter over there. You were asking 
about my strategy for the Spring Tenno 
Sho?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Wait, are you really going to teach 
me!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wonder~. Depending on the 
compensation... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
C-Compensation...!? I didn't do it for 
anything like—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Attention, Sei-chan fans~. Let's all have 
nap time in the courtyard~."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~! I wanna see Sei-chan's sleeping 
face~âª

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A-All right, all right! I'll give you 
information in exchange!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ho?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
About the upcoming Tenno Sho (Spring), 
according to a certain source... Special 
Week-san is... *mumble* *whisper*.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Well, that's great to knowâª"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Th-Then the strategy—

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, let's head out soon~. I want to 
give you a lap pillow already~!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, Mr. Reporter~. I've gotta run 
now~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Fan Appreciation Festival. So 
the fans come first and foremost~

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? B-But I paid the price for it, 
didn't I!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I did say 'depending on the compensation,' 
but I never said I'd definitely do it, did 
I~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll grant you an exclusive interview 
after the race, so let's call it even with 
that☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
N-No way... But if I get to interview them 
after the highly anticipated Tenno Sho 
(Spring)... that might not be bad.

Having found an exquisite compromise, 
Seiun Sky cleverly secured her nap time 
under the guise of fan service.
